text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume of "Project L'Arc" quietly 
waited for Mei Satake to speak.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Following the conclusion of this 
'Representative Exchange Match,' we will 
announce the members of the Japanese 
national team.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happens, win or lose. This 
is your last chance this year to show what 
you're truly capable of.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to pour out every ounce of 
your passion for the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"And even after you finish running, please 
do not forget. All the challenges you've 
faced up to now were possible only because 
it was you."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
No one here has slacked on their efforts. 
Every single one has poured their heart 
and soul into securing their victory.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
It's not just me; all of Japan 
acknowledges it. That's why everyone is 
cheering for you, entrusting you with 
victory in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The 4th match of the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe Representative Exchange Race 
begins.
